title: Simulated clinic protocol: needle accountability and observation

source.title: AcuCraft simulated clinic protocol
source.note: The simulated clinic's own procedure, not a regulator's text. It makes the proposal's needle-accountability and monitoring requirements checkable.

review.notes: A simulation protocol; a real clinic substitutes its own procedures.

rules.title: Count every needle before the visit ends
rules.summary: Before the patient leaves, a needle count reconciles every opened needle (in the sharps container, or with a recorded response if lost or broken).

rules.title: Observe the patient while needles are retained
rules.summary: Someone observes the patient at least every 10 minutes while needles are in place.
